LS01.en: A middle-aged Sui dynasty nobleman slumped at a low wooden table in a dim hall, wine cup tipped over, silk robes disheveled, expression of vacant indulgence, scattered bronze coins and empty jugs on the floor, warm amber lamplight, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS01.beat: 史书神话：醉眼惺忪的守财奴李渊

LS02.en: Two young men in dark Sui-era scholar robes speaking in low voices in a narrow shadowed corridor of a city yamen, one eighteen years old with sharp intense eyes, dust motes in a shaft of late afternoon light, tense conspiratorial atmosphere, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS02.beat: 十八岁李世民暗中联络刘文静

LS03.en: A candlelit inner palace chamber at night, two young palace women being half-led half-carried by attendants toward an ornate dragon-canopied bed, lowered eyes, spilled wine cup on the floor, heavy silk curtains, warm flickering candlelight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS03.beat: 晋阳宫：宫女被灌醉送上龙榻

LS04.en: Close-up of ancient Chinese official court chronicle volumes bound in yellow silk, a brush heavily crossing out lines of calligraphy, fresh black ink over older red cinnabar annotations, stacked bamboo slips beside, raking daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS04.beat: 评书味的源头：贞观年间重洗的官方实录

LS05.en: A lone surviving manuscript scroll with scorched edges resting on a campaign camp writing desk, candle stub burning low, a scholar-official in travel-stained robes writing by its light inside a military tent, shafts of dusk light through felt flaps, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS05.beat: 温大雅《大唐创业起居注》孤本

LS06.en: A steady-eyed mature commander reading a document by a window, jaw set, no trace of folly, sunlight on weathered face, plain unadorned study, quiet authority, photorealistic, cinematic portrait composition.
LS06.beat: 原始记录里没有糊涂老爹

LS07.en: Dawn over a northern Chinese fortress city in the Sui dynasty, watchtowers silhouetted against cold grey sky, thin smoke drifting from smithies, distant Taihang mountains, muted earth tones, photorealistic, cinematic wide shot.
LS07.beat: 大业十三年晋阳城，空气里飘着熟铁焦味

LS08.en: A fifty-two-year-old commander standing atop a city gate tower at night looking down, below him through a cutaway cellar three hidden furnaces glowing orange, freshly cast bronze coins pouring from pottery moulds into wooden crates, sparks rising, dramatic firelight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS08.beat: 城楼上的李渊与三座地下钱炉

LS09.en: A vast granary compound with gates flung wide, soldiers in leather armor loading sacks of millet onto heavy ox carts through the night into day, dust in the air, towering grain stacks behind, overcast northern light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS09.beat: 长平仓大门敞开，七十万石粟米装车

LS10.en: A powerful aristocratic clan head in formal dark silk seated in an ancestral hall, banners of the Eight Pillars of Northern Zhou behind him, stern composed face, incense smoke, symmetrical imposing composition, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS10.beat: 李渊真面目：北周八柱国、陇西李氏大当家

LS11.en: Endless columns of Sui conscript soldiers mired in muddy Korean peninsula lowlands under a bleak dusk sky, abandoned supply wagons, rain-slick ground, exhausted faces, desaturated cold palette, photorealistic, cinematic wide shot.
LS11.beat: 高句丽泥潭里的百万中原士卒

LS12.en: A sea of Turkic steppe cavalry riders in fur and lamellar armor massed on a northern horizon at dusk, countless raised bows, dust haze, low sun behind them, overwhelming scale, photorealistic, cinematic wide shot.
LS12.beat: 始毕可汗的四十万控弦之士

LS13.en: A young strategist's rolled battle map dropped unnoticed on a dusty floor beside the hoof-print-churned ground of an approaching steppe army, harsh midday light, sense of irrelevance, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS13.beat: 神机妙算在几十万铁骑面前一文不值

LS14.en: A mature man writing a letter by oil lamp in a plain campaign tent, brush pausing, letter paper bearing formal deferential phrasing, a folded felt tent flap and a steppe-style quiver hanging nearby, warm lamplight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS14.beat: 李渊亲手写给始毕可汗的信

LS15.en: A Sui imperial kinsman bowing deeply with forehead toward the earth before a steppe envoy in a dusty courtyard, attendants looking away in silence, long late-afternoon shadows, humiliation rendered without caricature, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS16.en: An open-air exchange ground: bolts of shimmering silk brocade being carried out of a government storehouse, matched by five hundred steppe warhorses and a column of two thousand Turkic riders waiting beyond, bright overcast light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS16.beat: 绫罗绸缎换五百匹战马两千突厥骑兵

LS17.en: A pre-dawn muster outside a northern city wall, torches, armored men and tethered horses, banners being unfurled, cold breath in the air, hard faces, the moment before a gamble, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS18.en: A great wooden river vessel weighing anchor at first light, its hold visibly loaded with chests of gold and silver and stacked curved steppe sabres, ropes straining, mist on water, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS18.beat: 大船起锚：真金白银与塞北弯刀

LS19.en: A war-room map of early Tang China with four hostile arrows converging from east, west, north and south on a tiny central plain, candlelight flickering over the parchment, sense of encirclement, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS19.beat: 最险恶的立国开局，四面漏风

LS20.en: Western Liang heavy cavalry in dark iron armor advancing across a high loess plateau at dusk, dust plumes, only a few dozen li from an unseen capital, urgent motion, photorealistic, cinematic wide shot.
LS20.beat: 薛举薛仁杲的西秦铁骑抵浅水原

LS21.en: An emperor alone on a vast throne dais in an enormous empty palace hall, sunlight pooling on empty floor, the scale of the room dwarfing the man, austere and lonely, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS21.beat: 太极殿上只有关中巴掌大的地盘

LS22.en: Two young princes standing back to back in a corridor of power, one facing an inner administrative courtyard, one facing an outer gate toward distant battlefields, split composition, cold daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS22.beat: 把两个嫡子掰成一内一外

LS23.en: A crown prince in formal crimson court robes seated at a long administrative desk reviewing ledgers, clerks working behind, calm and methodical, warm interior daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS23.beat: 李建成立为皇太子，守住机器的心脏

LS24.en: Officials with measuring rods and registers surveying fallow riverbank land, clusters of displaced farming families watching, Wei river willows, overcast daylight, documentary realism, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS24.beat: 清丈渭水两岸荒地，核查流民

LS25.en: A pontoon bridge of lashed boats across a swift yellow river, blacksmiths re-forging iron mooring cables on the bank, grain barges waiting, overcast northern light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS25.beat: 永丰仓军粮与蒲津关浮桥

LS26.en: A clerk at a stable-yard desk recording fodder rations in a ledger, warhorses tethered in rows behind, bales of hay, shafts of dusty afternoon light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS26.beat: 每匹战马都要登记草料定额

LS27.en: A young prince in battered black armor standing amid the aftermath of a battlefield at dusk, torn banners, fallen men and horses, exhausted but unbroken, cold blue-grey light, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS28.en: A commander dismounting on a barren plateau to eat a hard dry ration cake, three days of hunger in his face, campaign-worn soldiers resting nearby, harsh midday sun, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS28.beat: 浅水原断粮三天，下马啃干饼

LS29.en: Deep winter siege lines on a frozen hillside, soldiers' cloth boots rotted through with frost and mud, a commander who has not removed his armor for two nights, hoarfrost on iron, pale freezing light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS29.beat: 柏壁寒冬，布鞋冻烂在脚上

LS30.en: Three thousand five hundred heavy cavalry in black lacquered iron armor packed into a narrow mountain pass at dawn, motionless, spears upright, like an iron nail driven into the gorge, cold blue dawn light, photorealistic, cinematic wide shot.
LS30.beat: 虎牢关：三千五百玄甲幽州突骑

LS31.en: From a high ridge, a young general eating cold meat while studying an enemy array stretching twenty li across the plain below, countless tents and spears, hot hazy midday, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS31.beat: 窦建德十万大军列阵二十里，高岗啃冷肉

LS32.en: The instant of a charge: a black-mailed cavalry wedge exploding out of a pass, long lances leveled, dust and sun behind, violent forward motion, photorealistic, cinematic action shot.
LS32.beat: 长槊一指，黑色铁流撕裂长空

LS33.en: Two captured rival sovereigns being led in chains before a victory gate at dusk, banners lowered, the victor's army drawn up in ranks, exhausted triumph, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS33.beat: 一战擒窦建德、降王世充

LS34.en: A triumphal ceremony on a grand avenue of Chang'an, crowds, silk banners, imperial guards in polished armor, bright festival daylight, photorealistic, cinematic wide shot.

LS35.en: A young victor in gilded chainmail walking through the Vermilion Bird Gate, and above on the gate tower the aging emperor gripping the rail with visibly damp palms, the two men's eyes not meeting, bright but uneasy daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS35.beat: 黄金锁子甲踏进朱雀门，老皇帝手心冷汗

LS36.en: A vast intricate machine of interlocking wooden gears turning relentlessly in a dim hall, no hand on the lever, warm dusk light through high windows, quiet menace, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS37.en: A palace corridor with two rival processions passing in strained silence, courtiers looking down, the ordinariness of the moment belying what follows, flat even daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS37.beat: 玄武门的祸根不是赏罚不明

LS38.en: A cold eleventh-month court calendar page and frost on a palace window lattice, bare branches outside, pale winter light, still and ominous, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS39.en: An imperial edict scroll being unrolled before assembled officials, the characters for recruitment by examination stark in black ink, bright hall light, solemn reaction in the crowd, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS40.en: Extreme close-up of a Tang administrative compendium page, crisp black calligraphy on aged paper, a brush rest and ink stone beside, raking daylight on paper fibres, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS41.en: An abandoned examination hall with empty wooden cubicles, dust and fallen notices, a broken official seal on the floor, late dusky light through lattice windows, decay of institutions, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS41.beat: 隋朝科举与瘫痪的文官体制

LS42.en: A newborn wrapped in silk receiving a patent of fourth-rank nobility, a veteran general father looking on, ancestral plaques of the Western Wei military aristocracy behind, formal symmetrical composition, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS43.en: A battlefield quartermaster tallying severed heads against land grant certificates, soldiers waiting, grim transactional atmosphere under lowering dusk light, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS44.en: Scholars from distant provinces registering themselves at a prefecture gate at dawn, satchels and ink boxes, a torn notice board symbolizing the opened gate, fresh cold light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS44.beat: 撕开口子：允许自举赴京赶考

LS45.en: A crowd of eastern plains scholar-gentry and humbler students gathered in a dusty market town, uncertain hope on their faces, mixed silk and coarse cloth, overcast daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS46.en: A visual diptych within one frame: on the left a mounted cavalry standard, on the right a stacked set of law codes and administrative statutes, balanced composition, neutral light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS46.beat: 打天下靠骑兵，坐天下靠文官法典

LS47.en: Three civil officials in plain dark robes in conference in the Eastern Palace library, scrolls and maps spread on a low table, none of them of the Guanlong military clans, calm daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS47.beat: 东宫班底：魏征、王珪、李纲

LS48.en: Smoke over Hebei villages after a failed pacification by execution, displaced families on a road at dusk, a general's banner passing in frustration, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS49.en: Prison gates opened and grain being distributed to a thin crowd in a northern Chinese town, a crown prince's official supervising without guards drawn, plain daylight, documentary realism, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS49.beat: 建成怀柔：开释囚徒、发放民粮

LS50.en: An execution ground outside a city at dusk, a high official in bonds, assembled veterans of the original uprising watching in silence, restrained and sombre, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS51.en: Two senior ministers confronting each other across a court hall floor, factional officials lining the walls, taut stillness, cold flat light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS51.beat: 与裴寂争权的关陇顶级门阀

LS52.en: A market street cleared for an execution, household goods and chests being carried out of a great mansion by soldiers, onlookers silent, harsh midday light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS52.beat: 当街斩首，抄没全部家产

LS53.en: Senior armored nobles standing in a palace courtyard while a written rule is posted, their armor suddenly out of place among civil officials, long dusk shadows, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS54.en: A prince silhouetted against a looming mountain range that reads almost as a fortified compound, unseen masses behind him, low dusk light, scale and threat, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS54.beat: 算漏的一整座山：天策府

LS55.en: An extraordinary new patent of office being presented in a throne hall, no precedent for its rank, the recipient's face unreadable, courtiers whispering, bright formal light, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS56.en: A prince's own administrative staff being sworn in at a long table, maps of Luoyang and the eastern plains on the wall behind, quiet assumption of parallel government, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS56.beat: 自置官属与洛阳关东统辖权

LS57.en: A stream of armored officers entering a great mansion gate at dusk, welcomed by staff, the household swelling beyond its walls, warm interior light spilling out, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS57.beat: 天策府成了政治避难所

LS58.en: Iron filings gathering around a lodestone on a campaign map, and behind them the faces of hard-bitten cavalry commanders drawing close to a young prince, warm dusk light, metaphor rendered literally and physically, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS59.en: A vast net of administrative documents drawn tight across one half of a hall while hundreds of scarred veterans are pressed against the far wall, dusk light, structural confrontation, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS59.beat: 文官化收网 vs 百战功臣绝境

LS60.en: A great imperial machine being re-cast in the dark, military gears being pried out and replaced with bureaucratic ones, sparks, night, irreversible transformation, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS60.beat: 军事拓殖期向官僚帝国期的生死反扑

LS61.en: Transfer orders being issued in a ministry while steppe raid smoke rises on the northern horizon beyond the window, dusk, cold administrative light against distant fire, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS61.beat: 借突厥寇边之名调动天策府兵将

LS62.en: A grizzled general gripping his prince's hands at a city gate before exile, tears in his eyes, and behind them another general being taken under guard, long dusk shadows, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS62.beat: 程咬金外放，尉迟恭构陷

LS63.en: Two strategists in plain clothes being escorted out of a capital gate at dusk, looking back once at the walls, their official seals surrendered, cold air, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS63.beat: 房玄龄杜如晦被驱逐出京

LS64.en: A row of empty official seats in a prince's hall, one by one vacated, dust on the mats, a single remained loyalist standing, flat daylight, quiet political erasure, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS64.beat: 一颗一颗拔干净，不流血交班

LS65.en: A prince alone at a board game with every piece already lost, three scrolls of legitimate procedure beside him, low dusk light, defeat rendered without violence, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS65.beat: 论名分论行政论后援，全输光

LS66.en: A young prince being carried into a darkened mansion after a palace banquet, a servant's cloth stained with blood, overturned wine cups left behind, oil-lamp light, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS67.en: A shadowed room at night, faces of professional killers, cavalry officers and conspirators half-lit, a map of survival rather than ambition, no law books anywhere, hard low-key lighting, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS67.beat: 杀手网络被逼到绝境，不会讲程序正义

LS68.en: A stone tomb inscription tablet unearthed by lamplight, its carved characters catching the light, dust in the air, a slow sense of a mechanism turning, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS69.en: A mid-ranking guard commander in the livery of the Eastern Palace standing watch at a heavy northern palace gate in freezing November wind, face unreadable, frost on the gate studs, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS70.en: A single hooded emissary knocking at a small side door of a guard commander's house deep at night, one lantern, no escort, still street, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS71.en: A folded-edge steel gold-inlaid blade and several open chests of gold ingots on a plain table in a lamplit room, the light warm on metal, the recipient's hand hovering, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS71.beat: 折刃金刀与几箱沉甸甸的黄金

LS72.en: Close-up in darkness of an iron lock being replaced on a massive vermilion palace gate, a hand withdrawing a new key, moonlight edge, silence, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS73.en: A palace courtyard of grey brick after rain, still puddles mirroring a cold waning moon, black rooflines, absolute quiet before dawn, blue-black night, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS73.beat: 雨停，青砖积水倒映残月

LS74.en: Two men in coarse Taoist priest robes slipping through a shadowed service entrance of a prince's mansion at night, hoods low, one lamp in a servant's hand, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS74.beat: 房玄龄杜如晦化装成道士潜回

LS75.en: A scarred general in a rear courtyard at night wiping grease from a long cavalry lance, a whetstone and a bowl of cloudy water beside him, lantern light on oiled steel, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS75.beat: 尉迟恭擦马槊，磨刀石泛铁锈味

LS76.en: A prince writing a memorial by guttering candlelight at a low desk, brush moving steadily, the paper accusing his own brothers, shadows large on the wall, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS77.en: Nine warhorses tethered in a dark stable, wooden bits wedged in their mouths, hooves wrapped in thick hemp cloth, a groom's hand silencing one, single lantern, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS77.beat: 九匹战马塞木棍裹麻布

LS78.en: First grey light on the massive vermilion gate of a palace, an immense orderly structure about to be struck, a heavy iron hammer resting in the foreground, cold pre-dawn palette, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS78.beat: 秩序大厦即将迎来最血腥的一记重锤
